prompt: Which has better technology, First Light Fusion or Commonwealth Fusion Systems? Explain why.

First Light Fusion is a startup company founded by Dr. Omar Najafi, a former MIT professor. The MCFD uses a combination of magnetic fields to confine and heat plasma to fusion conditions. First Light Fusion has been working on this technology for several years and has made some progress, but they are still in the early stages of development.

Commonwealth Fusion Systems:
